title: Largest Contentful Paint
definition: LCP measures the time it takes to render the largest image or text block visible within the viewport. It marks the point in the page load timeline when the page's main content has likely loaded.
simpleExplanation: How long does it take for the giant hero image or the main headline to actually appear on the screen?
